audit_items.proof_trace: Config.validate() does not enforce fork epoch ordering (explicit TODO at L810-812). Misordered epochs cause phase_at_epoch() to return wrong phase since it assumes epochs match Phase enum order. Example: altair_fork_epoch=100, bellatrix_fork_epoch=50 causes epoch 75 to return Phase::Phase0 instead of Phase::Bellatrix.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker provides custom config with misordered fork epochs (e.g., bellatrix_fork_epoch < altair_fork_epoch). Node computes wrong phase for epochs, uses wrong fork version in signatures, causing attestations/blocks to be rejected and chain split.
